scope.summary: Warping/enveloping a StudioTextStory (arc, arch, bulge, wave, flag, fish, rise, and free-form envelope distortions, with orientation, bend, and horizontal/vertical distortion) is a StudioEffectStack operation owned by 14.5 (envelope/warp mesh) and 14.9 (live effects), applied non-destructively over a still-editable story. 14.7's contract is ONLY that the story remains a live, editable, re-shapeable StudioTextStory under the warp and that the shaping engine re-runs on edit; 14.7 does NOT define warp styles or the distortion mesh. Implement the type-side re-shape-on-edit contract + StudioEffectStack touchpoint.
acceptance_criteria: story stays live/editable under StudioEffectStack warp; shaping re-runs on edit; warp mesh owned by 14.5/14.9
expected_tests: live: story stays editable under a StudioEffectStack warp; editing text re-runs shaping under the distortion
test: 14.7 does not define warp styles/mesh (owned by 14.5/14.9), only the type-side re-shape contract

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Warped text bakes/loses editability; effect-engine ownership blurred.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
